name: Hololens 1.3.4 preview - original home layout and Scan/Battle swap
body:
Restores the original home layout and original holomem standing-art size. The large primary action is now Scan Cards with a clear camera icon; Start Battle occupies the previous Scan shortcut. Continue Match, the card-library shortcut, bottom navigation, original spacing and translucent panels are retained.

Includes the 1.3.3 Android ICU startup fix and existing card/translation data updates with immediate browsing/scanner refresh, website-aligned filters, 83 official characters / 602 artwork choices, separate app-release notices and optional ChatGPT AI alongside the original offline AI. Future card/translation corrections continue through the user-confirmed data update channel. New hSD20/hSD21 battle effects remain unsupported in this layout-only release.

Install this original-signer APK over the current app to preserve decks, collection, settings and saved matches. Do not uninstall or clear app data.

Validation: seven native bitmap comparisons match the original layout outside the two changed button regions, including the 946x2048 Vivi/resumable-match view, scrolled, narrow/large-font and new-art cases. All 517 existing portrait-layout entries and 79 existing character-style entries match the original baseline. Native host suite: 294/301 passed; seven exact pre-existing Windows directory-channel/fsync failures; no new failures, errors or skips. Native ICU: 21 compiled patterns / 50 Unicode boundaries passed. Release assembly, instrumentation compilation, lint (0 errors / 40 warnings), original v3 signer, APK contents and 16 KiB alignment verified.

Preview limits: this exact APK has not been visually tested on a physical Android device. Actual Android QuickJS JNI, camera, dual-device PvP and official ChatGPT Android login/account eligibility/live inference remain unverified. No live OAuth grant or inference usage was performed during development.
